_readme: DOCUMENTATION, BUT NOT UNREAD — a human/agent-facing record of third-party claims (ECharts version/license, SSR pattern sources) with retrieval provenance. Unlike its siblings labelled in this pass, this file IS named by real code: tools/corpus_check/guards/built_claims.py's `_THIRD_PARTY_RECORDS` exempts this exact path from the built-claims false-positive check, because its bare `owner/repo: command` attribution lines would otherwise misread as a claim this project runs that command itself; tools/tests/test_corpus_check.py asserts the exemption in both directions. So it is scanned and specially handled on every corpus_check run — 'no reader of any kind' does not hold for this one. Labelled 2026-08-23 (P8-084).
